h1: At Cirilo Design + Build, we are more than a new business — we are the result of years of hands-on experience, countless job sites, lessons learned the hard way, and a shared commitment to doing things the right way. From thoughtful design to quality execution, our mission is to create custom spaces that elevate how people live, gather, and enjoy their homes. We specialize in custom concrete swimming pools, outdoor living spaces, hardscapes, home renovations, additions, and new residential construction. Every project we take on is design-driven, detail-focused, and built with long-term value in mind

Cirilo Design + Build was founded by Ramon and Tiffany Cirilo with one clear goal: to create a design-build company rooted in experience, integrity, and craftsmanship. Ramon and Tiffany met over six years ago and built not only a life together, but a blended family grounded in hard work and shared values. Their professional backgrounds span different sides of the construction industry — Ramon with years of experience in large-scale civil construction, and Tiffany with a deep background in residential construction, custom swimming pools, outdoor living, and heavy equipment sales. Together, they bring a unique balance of structure, creativity, and real-world jobsite knowledge to every project. After years of working within larger organizations, they recognized a gap between how projects were sold and how they were delivered. Cirilo Design + Build was created to bridge that gap — offering homeowners a more transparent, hands-on, and thoughtfully managed building experience from concept through completion. As a family-owned and operated company, we take pride in being directly involved in every project. From custom concrete swimming pools and outdoor living spaces to renovations, additions, and new residential construction, our work is driven by design, guided by experience, and executed with attention to detail. At Cirilo Design + Build, we believe great spaces are built through clear communication, honest expectations, and respect for the craft. Our mission is simple: deliver quality work we’re proud to stand behind and create spaces that truly enhance how our clients live and enjoy their homes.
